name: Mains safety and isolation
description: Any net at mains or hazardous voltage, or a safety isolation barrier.
placement_rules: Primary/secondary separated by the barrier; fuse first; no logic within creepage of HV
routing_rules: Creepage/clearance from IEC 60664-1 for the working voltage (desk.ipc); slot where needed; no vias in the barrier
copper_rules: No pour across the barrier; edge setback for HV
emi_emc_rules: X/Y capacitors and CM choke per the filter topology
verification_requirements: Every HV net declared (fail-closed); creepage table per net pair; hipot plan (hardware)
